summary.text: Emilie Krasnow is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-9 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously worked as an assistant in the Vermont Senate and the lieutenant governor's office.

paragraphs.text: Emilie Krasnow was born in Middlebury, Vermont, and lives in Burlington.
She earned a bachelor's degree in leadership and management from the University of Notre Dame's Mendoza School of Business.
Her career experience includes working as an assistant in the Vermont Senate and in the lieutenant governor's office.
Krasnow assumed office on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate in the Chittenden-9 general election.
